Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:145723
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 28437 of 2023

Applicant :- Firoz
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Shamim Uddin Khan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Dr. S.B.Maurya, learned AGA-I, for the State, apprised the Court that on 24..6.2023 notice has been served to the informant of the case.
2. Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant.

3. Heard Sri Shamim Uddin Khan, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr.S.B.Maurya, learned AGA-I, for the State.
4. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.57 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366 and 376 IPC and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Sujanganj, District Jaunpur during pendency of the trial.
5.
FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and according to the FIR, applicant enticed away the minor daughter of the informant aged about 17 years.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
6. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that victim in the statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. did not make any allegation against the applicant and stated that she had gone along with applicant and applicant did not make any physical relationship with her but in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she stated that in spite of promise applicant did not perform marriage with her and made physical relationship with her consent.
7.

He further submits that even the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
stated that she wants to marry with applicant.

8. He further submits that as per school record and the report of CMO, the age of victim was around 16 years at the time of incident but physical appearance wise she appears to be more than 18 years of age.
9. He further submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 2.6.2023.

10. Per contra learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits that according to school record it appears that victim was hardly 16 years of age and in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she also stated that applicant made physical relationship with her under the false promise of marriage but could not dispute the fact that in her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
victim specifically stated that no physical relationship was developed between applicant and her.
11. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

12. Although from the school record it reflects that prosecutrix is about 16 years old at the time of incident and she in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. stated that applicant made physical relationship with her under false promise of marriage but in her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she categorically stated that no physical relationship was developed between applicant and her.
13.
Law is well settled that bail application should not be rejected either for punitive or preventive purposes.

14. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
15. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

16. Let the applicant-Firoz Alias Firoz Khan be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-

sentences.text: (i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
17. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

18. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
